edits.before: Garfinkel explains why the protocol is undocumented: it's background, and background is invisible. This explains what happens when you ask anyway. You get an answer. It is fluent, confident and constructed. That is not evasion and it is not a poor memory — the report was never introspective to begin with, so a better-motivated interviewee would produce the same thing.
edits.after: For week 2's interviews, a fluent explanation of a convention can be a plausible theory of it. The interviewee does not have to be evasive for the account to be mistaken.
